title: Kenyah people - Wikipedia
text: The Kenyah people are an indigenous, Austronesian -speaking people of Borneo, living in interior North and East Kalimantan, Indonesia and Sarawak, Malaysia. Categorised as a part of the Dayak people, they are similar to their neighbours, the Kayan people, with which they are grouped together with the Bahau people under the Apo Kayan people group.
